photometric_limit: Additive highlights are synthetic visual proxies, not a physical reflectance model.
occlusion_limit: Scoring uses common visible GT; offline clean return is not online tracking recovery.
efficiency_limit: Full RGB recomputation with CPU offload; offline batch throughput is not a clinical online frame rate.
SCARED_GT: Measured anchor only; no certified temporal pose GT.
C3VD_GT: 16 references in the N50 master pool; only selected reference frames are scored at each N. Use the shared first anchor when comparing quality across N. RGB and GT masks recovered from a pinned metric pool.

provenance.input_tensor_layout: contiguous BSCHW, same as native historical cached windows
